invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破639（基于ATR 3.26和日线熊市调整），或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（多头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 639 (adjusted based on ATR 3.26 and daily bearish trend), or funding Z-score falls below 50% (long risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.0925（基于ATR 0.0008和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（多头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.0925 (based on ATR 0.0008 and support), or funding Z-score falls below 50% (long risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2130（基于ATR 15.8588调整，上移止损以锁定部分风险），或融资费率Z-score回升至50%以上（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2062.29）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2130 (adjusted based on ATR 15.8588, moving stop up to lock in some risk), or funding Z-score rises above 50% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2062.29).
